_notes: Core numbers. Values in _picked were chosen by Claude as placeholders (Oscar: tweak freely). Everything else is from GAME_DESIGN.md or Oscar's Phase 1 answers.

starterLoan._notes: Principal = starter drone price - start cash (none if the drone costs less). Flat interest: total owed = principal x (1 + flatInterest), paid in termWeeks equal weekly payments. A missed payment adds the late fee to the balance and costs rep; missing repossessAfterMissedInARow in a row takes the drone. Early payoff = whatever is still owed, no penalty.

save._notes: A1: 4 game hours = 30 real seconds at 1x. Buying anything on a price pad also saves.

reputation._notes: levelThresholds[i] = rep points needed for level i (0-10). A6: rep per on-time job = onTimeBase 1 + pay/100 (about 1-16); late 0, very late -5; thresholds fitted by the balance bot so rep 1 ~15 min, rep 3 ~1h15, rep 5 ~3h, rep 8 ~6.5h, rep 10 ~9h of play.

_picked: arcade (all of it: real-second flight/render times, SD cards per flight, customer patience, pad recharge, price pad speed) - A1, retuned in A6
start.starterDrones media/thermal and save.autosaveEveryGameHours 4 (Oscar approved the media/thermal pick 2026-10-29)
A6 balance bot (test/balance, 2026-10-30): reputation (formula + levelThresholds), starterLoan.missedPaymentRep -5

arcade._notes: A1 (idle arcade). Job hours from jobs.json become real seconds at 1x. Flight: baseSec + secPerHour x flight hours, capped at maxSec. Render on the old laptop: scaleSec x renderHours^exponent, split evenly over the job's SD cards; a rig divides it by its PC tier speed and renders as many cards at once as the tier's queue slots. SD cards per flight: ceil(base + perFlightHour x flight hours), 1..max. A customer turns up when the ticket goes on a launch pad and waits patience = baseSec + factor x (flight + render seconds) before the job counts as late (late pay rules from jobs.json; 'very late' is one game day = 180 s past). Price pads: stand delaySec, then a full payment drains in fullSec. Before A4: SD cards per flight raised to ceil(2 + 2 x flight hours) (photos 3, wedding 6) so runners' stack upgrades matter; the render time is split across the cards, so the total is unchanged. rigBackedUpCards: a rig counts as full for the runner's 'When rigs are full' cloud setting when this many cards are waiting in its queue.
